title: TankPayloadV0
description: Typed payload for entity.type == 'tank_v0', grounded in raw wikitext sampled from ~26 diep.io tank pages (see docs/handoffs and the knowledge-schema-v0 evidence report). Upgrade relations are intentionally NOT modeled here -- they live as external relation_type=upgrades_to edges (see relation.schema.json) referencing this entity's id. Pages whose source structure violates normal single-tank assumptions (e.g. Dominator's multiple per-variant infoboxes and non-numeric tier) should be represented as unknown_entity instead of forced into this schema.

QualitativeStat.description: diep.io wiki BaseStats template fields are qualitative glyph ratings (e.g. ▲▲, ▼, —, N/A), NOT numeric gameplay statistics -- real numeric values only appear as free prose in the Technical section and are out of scope for this schema slice.

raw_value.description: The literal template field value as extracted from wikitext, e.g. '▲▲', '—', 'N/A'.

normalized_rating.description: A small signed integer magnitude derived from the glyph count when it can be safely normalized (e.g. ▲▲ -> 2, ▼ -> -1, — -> 0); null when the raw_value cannot be safely normalized (e.g. 'N/A', free text, or an unrecognized glyph). Normalization logic itself is not implemented in this schema slice -- this field is a reserved, nullable slot.

HiddenStat.description: One HiddenStat1..4/HiddenStat1..4Val slot pair. Labels are free text observed to vary per tank (e.g. Recoil, Bullet Accuracy, Field of View, Drone Count, Invisibility, Projectile Size, Damage Reduction) -- not a fixed vocabulary.

BaseStatsBlock.description: One {{BaseStats}} template occurrence. Hybrid-lineage tanks (e.g. sampled Gunner Trapper, Auto 5, Streamliner, Battleship) carry more than one of these on a single source page, distinguished by the wikitext PrevClass field.

source_class.description: Corresponds to the wikitext BaseStats template's PrevClass field, distinguishing which upgrade lineage this stat block applies to. Null when the tank has only one BaseStats block (the common case).

stats.description: Fixed diep.io stat vocabulary observed across all sampled tanks. Every key is optional -- e.g. the sampled Spike page's BaseStats block omits bullet_speed/bullet_penetration/bullet_damage/reload entirely, since Spike has no barrel.

TemporalSlots.description: Reserved nullable versioning slots. Not populated or inferred in this schema slice -- see docs/handoffs and the evidence report's note that Changelog-anchor links are real but extracting structured dates from prose is out of scope for v0.

tier.description: The wikitext infobox 'tier' field, as a small integer (observed 1-4 across sampled tanks). Pages with a non-numeric or hedged tier (e.g. Dominator's 'Supposedly 6') should not be modeled as tank_v0 at all.

source_tank_id.description: The wikitext infobox 'id' field (a small integer identifying the tank within the wiki's own tank-id scheme, distinct from the MediaWiki pageid already carried in provenance).

barrel_info.description: Raw text of the wikitext infobox 'barrel' field (e.g. '[[Cannons]] (1)', '[[Spawners]] (2) [[Drones]] (8)'), preserved verbatim. Structured weapon/barrel parsing is out of scope for this schema slice.

stat_blocks.description: One or more BaseStats blocks. Most tanks have exactly one; hybrid-lineage tanks have more than one (see BaseStatsBlock.source_class).

raw_infobox_evidence.description: Sparse bag of additional raw infobox field name/value pairs not otherwise modeled by this schema, preserved verbatim (e.g. the sampled Tank page's 'categories'/'key'/'releasedate' fields, which do not recur consistently enough across sampled pages to warrant a first-class field).
